D.t: Henry Cuellar leads by 14.2 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 37,384 votes; a one point swing is about 1,314 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +6.1 and D +22.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.1M cash against $214K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
